findings.element: RevRec · Schedule details table, row sub_after_release_3c1b, Schedule start column after the confirmation modal
findings.finding: After Confirm, the existing schedule's Schedule start is rewritten (28 Dec 2025 → 6 Jan 2026, and to the text "Payment date" on the next confirm), even though the modal the user just confirmed says existing schedules keep their dates.
findings.user_impact: An accountant who trusts the modal will see an existing $60,000 schedule moved from December 2025 to January 2026. Either the prototype teaches that a settings change re-recognizes revenue across a possibly closed period, or the real build does exactly that and silently restates the books.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep existing schedule rows unchanged on confirm, so only schedules built after the change pick up the new start date. Show a real date in the Schedule start column, never the option name "Payment date".

evidence.quote: The new Schedule start date applies going forward only. Existing recognition schedules keep their current dates.
evidence.source: Spec fact: "The change applies going forward only, and existing schedules keep their dates until a success specialist rebuilds a subscription. Changing the setting alone never re-dates existing schedules."

findings.element: PT · Sales tab · renamed "Payment posting date" select and its help text
findings.finding: The new label limits the setting to payments, but it actually dates every cash-side (balance-transaction) entry: sales receipts, refund receipts and expenses too. It also uses "posting"/"posts", which vocabulary.md replaces with Sync.
findings.user_impact: A bookkeeper may think this setting only dates payments applied to invoices, and may mix it up with the Summary "Payment date" option (when the customer paid). They could then pick the wrong basis for sales receipts and refunds and get the period cut-off wrong on cash-side revenue.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename it to a scope-accurate label without "posting", for example "Transaction sync date" (cash-side / balance transactions), and change "posts" to "syncs" in this help text and in the Invoice date help text.

evidence.source: vocabulary.md UI Words: "Sync (Synchronization) | post, push (syncing data from Synder to books)"; spec fact: the Sales-tab Posting date is the "cash / balance-transaction side" and is renamed only so it is not confused with Invoice date.

findings.element: PT · Invoices tab · RevRec lock: disabled Invoice date select and lock message
findings.finding: The locked select always shows "Created date", whatever date basis is actually in effect (pt-pro holds Issued). The lock also stays on after Schedule start is confirmed as Payment date, so the screen misstates both the active date basis and the lock rule.
findings.user_impact: An accountant reconciling RevRec against the books would read the invoices as dated on created when they actually sync on issued, and would cut off December/January wrongly. They would also be blocked from changing the setting in exactly the case the spec allows.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the Invoice date value actually in effect while locked, and derive the lock from the current Schedule start, enabling the select when Schedule start is Payment date.

evidence.quote: You cannot change Invoice date while revenue recognition starts from an invoice date.
evidence.source: Spec fact: "RevRec lock: if RevRec Schedule start = Invoice created date or Invoice issued date, the Sync Invoice date setting cannot be changed… If Schedule start = Payment date, the Sync setting can be changed."

gaps: Sync info / transaction drilldown (FDD S1.5) is not in the prototype, so I can't verify that the accounting entry date is shown and flagged when it differs from the created date in the transactions table.

Trial and new-connection states have no variant, so the Issued-date default for new connections and the trial availability are unverified. pt-pro opens on Issued without saying whether the connection is new or existing.

Below-Pro variant: the disabled select shows "issued". For an existing below-Pro connection (which should stay on Created and cannot change), I can't tell whether this is the value in effect or a placeholder.

Invoices tab: the Invoice date auto-saves ("Saved") and there is also an Update button ("Settings updated"). The map doesn't record whether Update re-commits or overrides the auto-saved Invoice date, or what happens if the user leaves without clicking Update.

Summary Sync: the claims "Default for the issued option is Invoice issued date" and "Datasource dating matches Per Transaction rules" have no source in the spec facts. I couldn't verify whether Summary dating really follows the PT Invoice date setting. It is unverified product logic.

Summary Sync plan gate: below Pro, the whole select is disabled, including the existing Invoice created date and Payment date values. The FDD conflicts on this (§2 gates only the new values, S2.3 says not changeable), so the right behaviour for existing below-Pro orgs can't be settled from the map.
"Learn more →", "How to change mode" and "Upgrade plan" links go to href="#", so I couldn't review their destinations.
